quiz.question: 1. Why must a project establish a baseline?
options: A. To make the report longer
B. To compare the candidate against a known reference under equivalent conditions
C. To guarantee the candidate is faster
quiz.explanation: A baseline (such as a single-threaded version or standard mutex) provides a scientific point of comparison. Without a controlled baseline tested under equivalent conditions, performance claims are meaningless.

quiz.question: 2. Which statement about concurrency testing is correct?
options: A. One successful run proves race freedom
B. ThreadSanitizer finds every possible concurrency bug
C. Stress tests and race detectors provide useful evidence but cannot prove all behavior correct
quiz.explanation: Concurrency bugs are non-deterministic. While ThreadSanitizer and stress tests provide strong empirical evidence, they explore only executed execution interleavings and cannot mathematically prove the absence of all races.

quiz.question: 3. What should a benchmark report include?
options: B. The workload, environment, methodology, repeated measurements, and limitations
C. Only a screenshot of a terminal
quiz.explanation: Rigorous systems benchmarking requires recording hardware topology, kernel version, compiler flags, fixed workloads, warm-up runs, median results, tail latency (p95/p99), and measurement variances.

quiz.question: 4. A component fails when its queue reaches capacity. What should its design specify?
options: A. A documented full-queue policy and test cases
B. Nothing if the queue is usually empty
C. That the error can be ignored
quiz.explanation: Failure handling is an explicit part of interface design. A bounded queue contract must document whether full queues block, drop oldest, reject with an error code (backpressure), or signal an event.

quiz.question: 5. What makes the capstone portfolio-ready?
options: A. A large codebase regardless of quality
B. A working implementation supported by tests, benchmarks, documentation, and a reproducible demonstration
C. A presentation without source code
quiz.explanation: Distinguished engineering portfolios demonstrate verified correctness, comprehensive automated testing, reproducible benchmark results, documented design trade-offs, and clear technical communication.
